主要内容: Aurora Cannabis Inc. filed multiple material change reports between October 5, 2017, and November 9, 2017, including the launch of Aurora Envoy, a patent-pending live plant transporter targeting the home grow market, a C$50 million prospectus offering upsized to C$60 million, a C$6 million private placement, and the closing of the C$60 million offering. The company also announced vaporizer sales through its website and the conversion of its C$25 million debenture. Additionally, it disclosed conditional approval to list on the TSX, passing the first stage of a German domestic production tender application, hosting an Australian delegation, and entering a technical services agreement with Cann Group Limited. The filings included audited consolidated financial statements for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2017, and unaudited condensed financial statements for the three months ended September 30, 2017.
